- ToolsetRegistry.AgentSkillToolset: 스킬의 나열, 읽기, 생성/업데이트에 사용되는 툴을 제공합니다.
- EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset: 언리얼 에디터 스테이트를 쿼리하고 수정하는 데 사용되는 툴입니다. 콘솔 변수,
에셋 이미징, 액터 및 에셋 선택, 뷰포트 카메라, 콘텐츠 브라우저 탐색, 에디터에서 플레이 세션 제어
등을 지원합니다.
- EditorToolset.LogsToolset: 언리얼 엔진 출력 로그를 읽고 로그 카테고리의 상세도를
제어하는 툴을 제공합니다.
- CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset: Cubeless native editor diagnostics, asset verification and compiler operations. Never reference this editor class from game assets.
- cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.toolsets.CubelessPythonDiagnostics: Cubeless editor Python startup and operation journal diagnostics.
- cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.toolsets.CubelessBlueprintTools: Cubeless Blueprint lifecycle tools with explicit compile, save, partial-failure and retry results.
- cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.graph_toolset.CubelessBlueprintGraphTools: Cubeless guarded K2 graph editing with object-path and GUID identities; compilation and saving are separate.
- cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.material_toolset.CubelessMaterialTools: Cubeless Material inspection and bounded graph edits. Maximum 2048 expressions; no explicit compile/save, shader completion or disk reload proof.
- cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.batch_toolset.CubelessBatchTools: Ordered Blueprint/graph/component actions sharing one durable journal, without automatic rollback/retry.
- cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.actor_toolset.CubelessActorTools: Cubeless loaded Actor inspection and single saved /Game persistent-level editing; no streaming/WP/external actors for mutations, no automatic compile/save. Transform JSON is at most 512 UTF-16 units with component magnitudes at most 1e12.
- cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.component_toolset.CubelessComponentTools: Cubeless bounded local Blueprint SCS inspection and guarded authoring. Inherited effective overrides and native CDO components are excluded. Loading may run PostLoad; mutations never request saving.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.actor.ActorTools: Provides tools for inspecting and modifying actors, including
    their transforms, labels, parent-child relationships, and components.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools: Provides tools for interacting with assets in the Unreal project and files on disk.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.blueprint.BlueprintTools: Provides tools for working with Blueprints.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.curve_table.CurveTableTools: Provides tools for creating and editing CurveTable assets.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.data_asset.DataAssetTools: Provides tools for working with Data Assets.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.data_table.DataTableTools: Provides tools for creating and editing DataTable assets.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.material.MaterialTools: Provides tools for creating and editing Material and MaterialFunction assets.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.material_instance.MaterialInstanceTools: Provides tools for creating and modifying MaterialInstanceConstant assets.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.object.ObjectTools: Provides tools for inspecting and modifying the properties of
    Unreal Objects and Unreal Classes, including those in Blueprints.
    Also use this toolset to discover available classes and subclasses.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.primitive.PrimitiveTools: Provides tools for adding primitive geometry components to actors.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.scene.SceneTools: Provides tools for working with the currently loaded level, including
    loading levels, placing and removing actors, controlling the level camera,
    and organizing actors in the outliner.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.skeletal_mesh.SkeletalMeshTools: Provides tools for inspecting and modifying skeletal mesh assets, including
    the mesh/materials, bone hierarchies, and sockets.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.static_mesh.StaticMeshTools: Provides tools for inspecting and modifying static mesh assets.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.string_table.StringTableTools: Provides tools for creating and editing StringTable assets.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.programmatic.ProgrammaticToolset: Batches calls to other registered tools through a small sandboxed Python
    script that glues them together with custom logic. The script's purpose is
    tool orchestration, not general Python execution.
- editor_toolset.toolsets.texture.TextureTools: Provides tools for working with Texture assets.

Explicit guarded replacement supports one exec source link to one exact old input and an empty new input, with current schema BREAK_OTHERS_A. Replacement requires an idle normal Blueprint, a directly owned standard K2 graph and native parent modules limited to Engine/CoreUObject. All four expected fields are required together with permission; a stale expectation fails before already-connected handling. The historical pipeline expected-field contract is restored here; the current UE56 wrapper did not expose those fields. Conversion/promotion nodes, data replacement, multiple old links, occupied new targets and compile/save remain unsupported. No atomic rollback or automatic retry. tools.description:

        Args:
            commands_json: JSON array of {"type":"CubelessBlueprintTools.create_blueprint","params":{"name":"BP_Name","parent_class":"Actor","package_path":"/Game/Blueprints"}} entries. Allowed CubelessBlueprintTools functions: create_blueprint, inspect_blueprint, compile_blueprint, compile_and_save_blueprint, compile_and_validate_blueprint, add_blueprint_variable, inspect_blueprint_variables, inspect_blueprint_variable_metadata, set_blueprint_variable_default. Function actions use existing selectors and strict JSON adapters, with native unsupported options rejected before mutation; create a function graph in a separate resolve action before adding its input/call node. They perform no explicit full compile/save. Graph selectors accept object-path node_id or native GUID; direct typed links preserve existing topology and refuse conversion/promotion nodes or link replacement. Member-node tools initially support locally declared variables only. Allowed CubelessComponentTools functions: list_blueprint_components, get_component_property, add_component_to_blueprint, set_component_property, set_static_mesh_properties, set_physics_properties. Use each individual tool's exact parameters/defaults except operation_id, which belongs only to the whole batch. Set component add compile_blueprint=false and variable default compile=false/save=false to accumulate edits before one final named compile/save action. Variable adds never request full compile/save; dry_run retains requested flags but executes neither. The named mesh setter accepts material for slot 0; material-only edits require static_mesh as an explicit empty string plus a valid material path. Omitted/null material preserves existing mesh-only batch replay. Physics defaults request no compile/save or running simulation; numeric int/float inputs normalize to numbers without the int32 coordinate restriction. Up to 1 MiB input. No legacy aliases, result references, arbitrary tools or nested batches. All command names/types are checked before any action. Individual domain restrictions still apply.
            stop_on_error: Defaults True. False continues only known failures; uncertain mutation, journal failure, PIE/session guard, or the 15-second between-step budget always stops. One engine call cannot be preempted.
            operation_id: Durable whole-batch ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Same ID and normalized inputs replay the recorded response without rerunning. Interrupted IDs never resume automatically.

        The named duplicate_blueprint_to_temp action is also supported under CubelessBlueprintTools with its individual defaults (dry_run=True, compile=False, save=True). It requires a clean saved source and SaveOnCompile=Never/source-control-disabled policy; engine implicit PostDuplicate compilation is separately reported. Overwrite and dirty-source cloning remain unsupported. It uses this batch journal, never a nested operation/retry.

        CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.add_blueprint_sequence_node is supported with its individual defaults and JSON position adapter; it adds 2..64 ordered exec outputs to an existing selected graph without compiler/save calls. It preserves GUID-valued node_id plus object_path. Its shared creation core and the existing Branch tool verify old graph topology. All domain limitations still apply.

Replacement requires allow_pin_link_replacement=true and all four expected fields naming exactly one current exec edge with schema break_others_a; the new target must be empty. Native dispatch rechecks the guard after checkpoint. Compile/save flags must remain false. Reconnecting the old path is a separate explicit action; failure can leave a partial chain, never an atomic transaction. Existing connect_graph_pins remains replacement-free with its original signature and journal fingerprint.

        CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.add_blueprint_event_node and the new add_blueprint_parent_function_call extension share the same durable action core. Their existing graph selectors, JSON positions and explicit unsupported options match the named tools. No implicit wiring/full compile/save. Actor Blueprint parents are admitted only by the saved clean compiled chain/dependency guard; native parent creation/duplication defaults and replay fingerprints remain unchanged. Component getters support the audited local generated ActorComponent scope described by their individual tool.

        Returns:

Full compilation/saving occur in explicitly requested actions; engine factories and structural edits may perform separately reported implicit compiler work. One transaction scope does not promise atomic rollback, disk recovery or all-action Undo support. Completed reads replay historical results for the same ID.
